scope: 106 completed two-stage decisions (212 forward passes), including Agent steps and the decision preceding a downstream timeout; no new model calls.

boundaries.decision_service_ms: decision_calls[i].timings.service_reported_ms: Liquid server timer after acquiring its lock, including system_one input processing, forward execution, CUDA synchronization and cleanup; excludes lock wait and HTTP; not GPU kernel time.
boundaries.decision_stage_ms: Saved history assessment_ms, selection_ms and model_decision_ms: decision-stage application timings, including decision-service queueing, communication, validation and selection evidence preparation; excludes full gateway routing, target execution and public end-to-end time.

percentile_method: Nearest rank, sorted values[ceil(n*p)-1], matching app.gateway_store.percentile; combined values are computed per request before calculating percentiles.
concurrency: Ordinary tasks at most 2 concurrently; Agent tasks followed; not a load or SLA test.
